newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait Stock Exchange to list investment company.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait Stock Exchange to list investment company.

text.p: The Kuwait Stock Exchange (KSE) has agreed to list the International Investment Projects Co (IIPC) share as of Saturday, the company said on Wednesday.
"The board of IIPC is pleased to announce that the KSE management has agreed to list the company share for trade starting Saturday March 29," a company statement said.
IIPC had its name changed from Kuwait Investment Group in December 1996.

In August 1996 Kuwait International Investment Co (KIIC) bought about 70 percent of IIPC's shares from private investors and raised its capital to a current 50 million dinars ($165 million) from six million at the end of 1995, an IIPC official said.
IIPC's "main target is to play an active role in the real estate market as well as in investments," the official said.
IIPC reported a net profit rise to 1996 to 7.8 million dinars from 554,000 in 1995 and a loss of 71,000 in 1994.
Its total assets amounted to 62.246 million dinars at the end of 1996 compared to 6.1 million at the end of 1995.

Trade on the KSE is restricted to nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Foreign residents of the Gulf Arab state can invest through listed funds managed by local firms.
